description: This file defines the Cart controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages cart-related functionalities such as displaying the cart contents, removing items, and providing cart info via AJAX endpoints.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class handling shopping cart operations, including rendering cart content, removing items, and providing cart info via AJAX.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the cart view with product details, totals, and links, and handles price visibility based on customer login status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs the cart view as a response, used for AJAX updates.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart based on a provided key and returns success or error in JSON format.
